settings.title: Settings
settings.fqdn_help: Changing this hostname also requires updating the server URL in existing BBS agents.
settings.tls_help: When disabled, NethServer uses its default certificate. BBS agents must trust that certificate; use a trusted certificate for unattended clients.
settings.ssh_port_help: This TCP port is opened in the NethServer firewall and advertised to agents. Restart existing agents after changing it. Configure any router or NAT separately.
settings.invalid_fqdn: Enter a valid fully qualified domain name, such as bbs.example.com.
settings.invalid_ssh_port: Enter an unused TCP port from 1024 to 65535.
settings.port_in_use: This TCP port is already in use on the node. Choose another port.
settings.admin_password_notice: Set a password here only during initial configuration. NethServer does not store it after BBS initializes.
settings.admin_password_help: Optional. Set this only before BBS is initialized. Leave blank to let BBS generate a password. After initialization, use Advanced options to change it.
settings.admin_password_reset_notice: In this section, you can change the password for the standard BBS admin account and optionally remove its local TOTP setup and recovery codes. Removing 2FA also changes the password. If the password fields are empty and 2FA is unchecked, Save only changes the hostname, certificate, or Borg SSH port. This does not affect MFA managed by an external OIDC provider.
settings.new_admin_password_help: The new password applies to local BBS login. Use 8–72 UTF-8 bytes.
settings.invalid_reset_admin_password: Use 8–72 UTF-8 bytes on one line, without NUL characters.
settings.password_required_for_2fa_reset: Enter and confirm a new password to remove 2FA.
settings.reset_2fa: Also remove local 2FA (TOTP and recovery codes; requires a password change)
settings.confirm_admin_password_reset: The password for the standard BBS admin account will be replaced. Continue?
settings.confirm_admin_password_reset_2fa: The password for the standard BBS admin account will be replaced, and its local TOTP setup and recovery codes will be removed. MFA managed by an external OIDC provider is not affected. Continue?
settings.admin_password_reset_success: The password for the standard BBS admin account was reset.
settings.admin_password_reset_success_2fa: The standard BBS admin password was reset, and its TOTP setup and recovery codes were removed.
settings.admin_password_already_initialized: BBS is already initialized. Change the administrator password from the BBS web interface.
